stemMarkdown: Two trains, 200 m and 150 m long, are running towards each other on parallel tracks at 72 km/h and 36 km/h. How many seconds do they take to cross each other completely? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Opposite directions means the speeds add: $72 + 36 = 108$ km/h $= 30.0000$ m/s. They must cover the sum of their lengths, $200 + 150 = 350$ m, so the time is $\dfrac{350}{30.0000} = 11.6667$ seconds.
